notes.title: Update V 1.9.2 - Gameplay Enhancements +
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831347/451d754f71c1848db5d8dc06b11dc37ac9201063.png[/img]

Lots of new features for this update.

BOTS & SPAWNERS HAVE HEALTH BARS
Players can now see how much damage a bot has taken and how much health it has left.

CUSTOMIZABLE CHARACTER COLOUR
12 colours to choose from. Player health bars, dead player ragdolls and player spawnable turrets will match the selected colour.

IMPROVED BOT SPAWNER DEFENSES
Bot Spawners will now detect if a player is in close range and emit a plasma shock wave to damage and repel the player. These shockwaves can also damage nearby bots, allowing the player to trigger them tactically. Frequency of shockwaves adjusts to player difficulty level.
Shockwave graphic and sound effect added.
Spawner defensive guns will now only rotate to face player if the spawner has recently taken significant damage. Use tactical retreats to trick spawners into switching off their targeting system.

PRIMARY PLAYER TURRETS HAVE A.I.
Player spawned turrets now act independently, targeting and shooting enemies in range (including vertically for taking down flying enemies or enemies on higher or lower platforms). These are now now a powerful weapon. In PvP mode they target all players other than the player who spawned it.

DEAD PLAYERS SPAWN A TURRET
Brought back this feature from early in the game development, but updated. If a player dies and other players are doing battle the dead player ragdoll will spawn a turret. In PvP mode this turret will target all remaining players, becoming an additional hazard in their battle. In PvBots mode the spawned turret will assist the remaining players by targeting bots.

SECONDARY PLAYER TURRETS IMPROVED
The alternate player turrets (launched in Aim Mode then dragged by the player for aiming) now have a wider spread of bullets, making them much more useful in combat. They now also auto detect whether the player has moved into position to take control of their movement, generating a harness around the player, plus red light indicators. 

BOT ARENAS 1, 3 & 7 EXPANDED
Additional room layouts with new graphical features.

NO RETREAT
In PvBots mode each room will automatically block off the exit to the previous rooms. Prevents players from easily escaping to recover health, ammo and weapon pick-ups. Also stops bots from randomly wandering off into previous rooms.

EXIT INDICATORS
After clearing a room in PvBots mode, an arrow indicator will point the way to the next room.

BOT WALL DETECTION BEFORE SHOOTING
Most bots (and spawners) now use a twice per second ray cast function to detect obstacles directly ahead of them. While an obstacle is detected the bot will be unable to shoot. Prevents bots shooting repeatedly against walls directly in front of them and fixes a bug where bots were able to shoot through walls at extremely close range. (path finding will be a priority for the next game updates)

GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS
[list]
[*] New textures and environmental architecture added to some Bot Arenas.
[*] Spawnable turret model improved.
[*] Player arrow changed to a coloured ring with small directional arrow pointer, as found in many top-down co-op games. Player can toggle the ring on / off by pressing down on the D-pad. These also switch off in dark arenas if the player switches off their flashlight.
[*] Player health bars have a thin white border extending up to the 100% full mark. Easier to tell, at a glance, how much health they a player has in relation to full capacity.
[*] New lighting visual effect added to all bot spawns.
[*] New UI pics added to menus for Bot Arenas 1, 2, 3, 4 & 7.
[/list]
NEW MUSIC ADDED
One new piece of music and five new remixes of existing music.

MINOR CHANGES & BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Enemy version of player spawnable turrets added to game and placed in some arenas. Watch out for them. They can target you from below or above.
[*] Spiders are less jumpy. Previously their wall climbing and leaping caused them to hover in the air a lot. They’re now more frequently grounded.
[*] Inflatable bombs can now explode upon touching an enemy (with a half second delay fuse after being fired). 
[*] Regular grenades have a shorter fuse and cause a larger explosion.
[*] Player ammo increased by 30%.
[*] When player enters shimmy mode for slipping through tight spaces, their movement speed wasn’t slowing down (fixed).
[*] Starburst weapon in aim mode was sometimes causing wide firing of directional fireworks immediately after being fired (fixed).
[*] Starburst aim mode and inflatable bombs sound fix (they don’t drown out audio channels any more).
[*] Hover board weapon cool down added.
[*] Reduced all player health in PvP matches. Was too high before.
[*] Rotating architecture elements were freezing in place and not rotating (fixed).

[/list]

notes.title: V 1.9.1 – Better graphics and gameplay mechanics +
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831347/52b32344cc7932b4709c7eef8589d6da62d11892.png[/img]

[b]IMPROVED PLAYER CONTROLS[/b]
Right stick no longer contributes to movement speed (Makes aiming easier when not in Aim Mode).
Changes to button controls allow for easier use of Aim Mode, toggling of camera distance and player dash move.
Updated player controls image in menus.

[b]DASH & BASH[/b]
The player’s dash move will now cause explosion damage to enemies on impact, with a small amount of damage sometimes taken by the player. Useful if low on ammunition. Doesn’t damage other players during Co-op mode.

[b]AIM VIEW CAMERA IMPROVEMENT[/b]
When the player enters Aim Mode the camera will offset itself from the player’s position to show a further range of the terrain ahead of them, but also reduces view of what is behind the player. The offset cancels itself if the player is close to a wall or other obstruction (prevents the camera moving outside of the arena walls). The distance of the offset also adjusts according to the camera’s height from the player (zoom your camera out to get the furthest view of the terrain).

[b]PICK UP INDICATORS[/b]
Collecting a weapon, health boost or ammunition now triggers a brief graphical display that floats up from the player’s position, indicating what item has just been collected. Player health share in Co-op mode also triggers this display.

[b]GUIDED ROCKETS[/b]
Player can use the right stick to curve the flight of a rocket immediately after firing. Use it to guide rockets around corners and obstacles. Only works in Aim Mode.

[b]HOVERBOARD IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Hoverboards are now easier to get into and less likely to throw the player off when moving at high speeds or over ramps. Improved the model and textures of the hoverboards.

[b]IMPROVED VISUAL EFFECTS[/b]
Significant improvements to visual effects for wall penetrator bullet impacts, flame thrower fire and all explosions.

[b]BETTER TEXTURES[/b]
Many textures for enemies and environments have been changed to include “normal maps”. These maps alter the calculation of light reflections to make flat surfaces look 3D. This helps get rid of the previous “early Playstation” look of the game. With these new textures many of the arenas look a lot better now graphically, though not all arenas include them yet.

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced health amounts on enemy tanks. They were too high before.
[*] Bot Arenas 4 & 6 have much more variation in how their rooms procedurally generate.
[*] Arena 4 boss – fixed a bug that was previously causing it to sometimes stop fighting mid-battle.
[*] Assorted small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: V 1.9 - Enemy Variants +
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831347/6a01848379b6a87aa2f569bf232ef1a39487f962.png[/img]

ENEMY VARIANT RANDOMIZATION
Most enemies (including some bosses) can now generate at least a half dozen variants, randomizing visual appearance and / or combat abilities. These include variations on:
[list]
[*] Physical size
[*] Health amount
[*] Number and types of weapon
[*] Combat range
[*] 3D model design
[*] Model textures
[*] Speed
[*] Jump height
[*] Other combat A.I. variants
[/list]
The full range of these variants is too much to list here. Play the game and you'll encounter over 100 variants.

OTHER CHANGES INCLUDE:
[list]
[*] Players now have a directional arrow attached to them for clarity, this helps with aiming and identifying other players. Can be toggled on and off with the flashlight in dark arenas, so as not to interfere with stealth combat.
[*] Full redesign of Drone 1 enemy,  including new animations.
[*] Graphical overhaul of explosion effects and rocket launcher smoke trail.
[*] Fireballs now bounce up to three times, making them more useful in combat.
[*] Fireballs now reduce player ammo more, given they are more powerful.
[*] Wall penetrator bullets now also damage bot spawners.
[*] Improvements to environmental graphics in Bot Arenas 3, 4 & 5.
[*] The pistol bullet, when fired in aim mode, now shoots a remote control bullet, which the player can control with the right stick to shoot around corners.
[*] Graphical improvement to the doors separating rooms in Bot Arenas.
[*] Lots of new textures added to the robot variants.
[*] Player 2 ragdoll physics bug fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: V 1.8 - BOSS BATTLES plus - Part one
notes.content:
BOSS BATTLES
This updates adds a unique boss battle to each of the first four Bot Arenas (more boss battles will be added in future updates). Each of the first four arenas now has an additional room added to its ending, where the new bosses can be fought. These bosses have multiple independently animated body parts and multiple modes of attack.

BOT SPAWNERS HAVE DEFENCES
Bot Spawners were previously too easy to destroy, so now they have a chance to spawn with their own rotating gun and defense shields. The guns can have up to two fire modes (one for close defending and one for distant) and the shields can spawn in different orientations. Bot Spawners will remain defenseless in beginner mode, while the chance and power of defences spawning increases with higher game difficulties.

PLAYER HEALTH REGENERATION
A major problem with gameplay flow was that when the player had very low health they would have to wander the edges of the arena (sometimes for several minutes) hoping to find a medikit thrown by the crowd before bots had a chance to kill them. All players now have automatic health regeneration, which only kicks in when the player hasn’t taken damage for a certain amount of time (between 4 and 12 seconds, depending on gameplay difficulty level). The speed of health generation is also affected by game difficulty level. This mechanic also reduces the overall game difficulty, as I’d previously had reports of the game difficulty being too high even on the lower difficulties.

PLAYER CAMERA IMPROVEMENT
The player camera now has a third height position, allowing for a much closer view of the player and close enemies (good for short distance weapons like swords, flamethrowers and shotguns). Player still toggles between these camera heights using the upper D-pad button.

PLAYER APPEARANCE
Have darkened the player colours and made their material less shiny. Was looking too plastic previously.


BUG FIXES

After playing a PvP arena, then returning to main menu, the next PvP game selection screen would initially show the wrong arena choice. Fixed

In multiplayer, if one player dies and becomes a turret, pausing the game would then cause the turret’s camera to block a portion of the pause menu screen. Fixed.

Fixed disjointed shadows in Bot Arena 9.

Bot Trooper 5 (the sky blue one) was jumping far too often, making them very difficult to shoot. Reduced their jump frequency.

Visibility of UI elements (health and ammo bars). Sometimes these were being obscured when the player walked very close to arena walls. Being that I’m using Unity’s built-in render pipeline for faster game performance, I’ve been unable to layer over an additional camera to ensure UI always displays in the foreground. Have worked around this by significantly reducing the size and proximity of the UI displays in relation to player camera. This has massively reduced the amount of obstruction from arena walls.

notes.title: V 1.7 - Damage Flash and other improvements
notes.content:
[h1]TO THE DEATH – V 1.7 (DAMAGE FLASH UPDATE)[/h1]

[h2]Small, but important, enhancements.[/h2]

[b]DAMAGE FLASH[/b]
Players, Bots and Bot Spawners now have model parts that flash in response to taking damage, making it more clear to players whether they are successfully damaging enemies / taking damage. This is especially helpful with larger enemies that have more health.

[b]CHANGES TO PLAYER CONTROLS[/b]
Previously the player would use Right Trigger to fire main weapon and Right Bumper to fire secondary weapon. This was a bit strenuous on the player’s right finger. Now the Left Trigger fires the secondary weapon. This also allows players to shoot both of their weapons at the same time.
The left or right Bumpers can now be used to make the Spawnable Player Turret shoot or make the Hoverboard shoot if the player is riding one.
Player controls display in the Main Menu and Pause Menu has been updated accordingly. It now also includes brief explanation that player weapons function differently in Aim Mode.

[b]BOUNCE PAD IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
Previously the bounce pads would physically move upwards to bounce the player then move back to the ground. The latter part was causing some physics problems (eg, bounce pads getting stuck if an object prevented it falling back down). Bounce Pads now remain still and bounce the player by spawning an invisible floor that shoots upward then disappears. This has solved the previous physics problem.
Also, the centre of each bounce pad will now flash when bouncing a player or robot.

[b]PLAYER MODEL CHANGES[/b]
In PvP dark arenas, players were unable to effectively hide from other players because most of the weapons had luminous parts on them. The luminosity on all player model parts, and the player’s eyes, have now been removed, allowing for better dark arena stealth tactics.

notes.title: V 1.6 - CROSSFIRE UPDATE
notes.content:
[b][u][h1]TO THE DEATH – V 1.6 (CROSSFIRE UPDATE)[/h1][/u][/b]

This update adds lots of new features to the game, including major enhancements to co-op gameplay.

[h2][b]UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2]

[b]CROSSFIRE MODE[/b]
This unique game mechanic allows two or more players to damage enemies by crossing their Aim Mode laser sights over each other. When two laser sights touch each other they switch from a red beam to a damaging white beam. The white beams will cause explosions at any point where a robot crosses their path, even through walls, and requires no ammunition to use. Encourages co-op players to co-ordinate their attacks against enemies.

Crossfire mode also plays a role in single player. Several Player Vs Bots arenas now have laser sight beams randomly built into the arena architecture. The player can cross their own beams over them to damage enemies.

[b]PLAYER HEALTH SHARE[/b]
During co-op games in Player Vs Bots arenas, players can touch each other to share their existing health. On touch, the two players’ health amounts are added up then evenly divided between them. This play mechanic can be used to save a co-op friend whose health is so low they’re at risk of dying. Like crossfire mode, this encourages co-ordinated gameplay tactics in multiplayer. Feature is disabled in PvP gameplay.

[b]PLAYER BOUNCE[/b]
Players can now use each other as a bounce pad by jumping directly on top of each other. Works in PvP and Co-op modes.

[b]NEW BOT ARENA – THE BLACK HOLE[/b]
This dark arena is the first Player Vs Bots arena to feature dark rooms in which players must use their flashlights to see their surroundings. Beware enemies hiding in the dark. Four rooms, each with their own graphical style. There are now nine PvBots arenas with more to be added soon.


[h2][u][b]ADDITIONAL UPDATE FEATURES[/b][/u][/h2]

[b]SPIDER NAVIGATION[/b]
Spiders were frequently getting trapped against walls and corners when pursuing the player. They now have both sidestep and jump abilities if they encounter a close obstacle. They can sometimes even reach you on very high ledges.

[b]MORE ARENA LAYOUT RANDOMZATION[/b]
All bot arena now feature randomized layout generation for all rooms. Previously bot arenas 6, 7 and 8 had a fixed, unchanging layout. In a future update PvP arenas will all have layout randomization too.

[b]TURRET ADDITIONS[/b]
The Spawnable Strong Turret (spawn it by throwing a collected turret spawner while in Aim Mode) now has an Aim Beam the player can tactically use to with the Crossfire mode mentioned above. Both types of spawnable turrets now have more health. The spawnable strong turret will now also shoot at players in PvP matches.

A new Fixed Strong Turret (identifiable by their hexagonal base plate) is now built into some bot arena generation. These are stationary turrets that shoot at any player or robot that crosses their path. Use them tactically to kill enemies, but beware they don’t kill you. They can be destroyed, but have a lot of health.

New Fixed Aim Beam turrets. These are smaller environmental features in some arenas. They project a fixed Aim Beam that doesn’t shoot at anything, but players can use them in combination with their own Aim Beam to trigger Crossfire attacks. Can also be destroyed.

[b]NEW MUSIC[/b]
Approx eight new mixes added.

[b]PLAYER MOVEMENT[/b]
Player can now jump approx. 25% higher. Player can now move approx. 40% faster when using Aim mode, but still slower than normal movement.

[b]GRAPHICS[/b]
Dozens of new environmental textures added.

[b]ASSORTED BUG FIXES[/b]

notes.title: V 1.5 - EXPANDED WEAPONS UPDATE
notes.content:
All fourteen weapons now have two fire modes, effectively doubling the number of weapons in game, while allowing the player to make use of four fire modes when holding two weapons. The new fire modes are used when the player enters Aim Mode during battle (see in-game control menu if you're not familiar with the aim mode feature). These new modes are often very different to the main fire modes and most of them allow for new tactics in gameplay. The fire modes are as follows:

[olist]
[*] SHOTGUN - Normal Mode = short, but wide blast. Aim Mode = concentrated blast at longer range.
[*] RIFLE - Normal Mode = green rapid fire lasers. Aim Mode = shoot damaging glueballs, which can trap an opponent in corners or block their path.
[*] STARBURST - Normal Mode = Short distance shot thatslows and explodes in firework display. Aim Mode = Longer Distance shot that detects players or enemies it pases by and shoots secondary fireworks in their direction. Also makes large explosion at end of its directional path.
[*] PISTOL - Normal Mode = Powerful blue bullets, but low rate of fire. These bullets can bounce off one wall only. Aim Mode = Adds more damage power and changes bullet colour to a more purple tint.
[*] SWORD - Norman Mode = Swingable laser sword that causes small explosions on contact with players, enemies or spawners. Aim Mode = Sword can be thrown. Damages enemies on impact and sometimes comes to rest on floor and can be collected and reused.
[*] REBOUNDER - Normal Mode = Yellow lasers that travel slowly and do low damage, but can bounce off walls up to four times. Aim Mode = Higher damage orange lasers that can bounce up to six times. Cause medium explosions on contact with players / robots. Lower rate of fire than Normal Mode.
[*] WALL PENETRATOR - Normal Mode = Pink / purple energy balls that travel through walls, but have limited range and are blocked by shields. Aim Mode - Faster version with longer range.
[*] GRENADES - Normal Mode = Black and yellow grenades that bounce and explode after a set amopunt of time. Aim Mode = Orange grenades that instantly explode on impact with a player, robot or spawner.
[*] MINES - Normal Mode = Throws black mines that explode if a player or robots passes close to them. also self-destructs after 20 seconds. Aim Mode = Metallic mines that act in the same manner, but are more sensitive to nearby movement and cause a cluster of explosions when detonated.
[*] FLAMETHROWER - Normal Mode = Flames that do rapid damage, but limited in range. Aim Mode = Shoot a slow moving, but powerful fireball. Explodes on impact.
[*] INFLATABLE BOMBS - Normal Mode = Rapid shooting of small white grenades which expand like balloons befor exploding. Aim Mode = Shoot one very powerful balloon grenade at high speed. Very low fire rate. Causes high damage, pushes enemies back and bounces rapidly around the arena for a couple of seconds.
[*] ROCKETS - Normal Mode = Fire rockets upward. They arch back down to the ground, causing medium explosion on impact. Aim Mode = Fire an accelerating rocket horizontally with no gravitational falling.
[*] SPAWNABLE TURRETS - Normal Mode = Create a player-coloured turret which can be directly controlled and fired by the player (see in-game control menu) and self-destructs after three mins. Aim Mode = Create a silver, rapid-fire, turret that automatically shoots if a robot passes it's path (also shoots at players in PvP battles). This turret has a metal brace at the back which players can jump into and use to move and aim this turret.
[*] SHIELDS - Normal Mode = Hold out a large shield. Press again to place the held shield into the worldspace. Explodes after approx one minute. Aim Mode = Hold and place the same shield at a 90 degree angle. When placed becomes a platform that can be jumped on (perhaps allowing the player to access higher ground they otherwise can't reach. Stack them like stairs to get to much higher ground)
[/olist]

A variety of other small improvements have been made to the game. Too many to list here, but here are some.

PUSHABLE AUTO-FIRE CANNONS - These now have higher health and easier to move / aim, and can even be pulled.
IMPROVED WEAPON EFFECTS - Applies to a handful of the weapons, such as better looking flames.
IMPROVED APPEARANCE ON SOME ENEMIES - particularly the black flying drone and the larger flame trooper.
HOVERBOARD IMPROVEMENTS - Higher rate of fire and higher health.
COLLECTIBLE SPAWN RATE - Weapons, health kits and ammo are now thrown less frequently into the arena. Increased player ammo by 70% to compensate.
ARENA GENERATION - Some small bug fixes to prevent spawners appearing high above ground, corrected a few overlapping texture glitches.

notes.title: V 1.4 - Graphics and animations update (among other additions)
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@robagergames][img]https://www.collativelearning.com/PICS%20FOR%20WEBSITE/TO%20THE%20DEATH%20game/TO%20THE%20DEATH%20anims%20update%20promo%20pic.png[/img][/url]

This is a fairly large update that makes a lot of changes to the look and gampelay.

HIGHLIGHTS INCLUDE:

[olist]
[*] Three new player abilities - SIDESTEP (for squeezing through tight gaps), LEDGE CLIMB / VAULT (jump and grab a ledge to pull yourself up) and SWORD SWING (use the main fire button to swipe instead of having to rotate your character).

[*] Nine new player animations, including recoils, dash, jump, laser sight aim, throw and anims for the new player abilities listed above.

[*] The player's currently held weapons are now visible on the player model, lest you forget which weapons you are holding. These player model changes are integrated with all the new animations.

[*] Most enemy bots now have additional animations and, in some cases, new abilities and enhanced A.I. For example, shotgun troops can now deliver a melee attack up close befor backing up for another gun blast.

[*] Three new enemy types with animations. There is a larger, more powerful version of the flame trooper and two giant robot spiders of different sizes, speeds aand strength.

[*] Drone Bot 2 has been completely redesigned and programmed. It can do flying attacks, but can also land and attack on foot. Animations added for these attack modes.

[*] The Tank Turret and Tank Cannon bots have been redesigned. They're a little bigger, more detailed and now perform much smoother in the physics engine, meaning less jitter and the top sections don't fall loose from the main body any more.

[*] Enhanced environmental graphics now include decorative elements such as steel pipes and other indutrial items, gold engravings on the marble walls in Bot Arena 2, web-like circuitry and PC cooling pipes in Bot Arena 4, loose bricks in stone wall arenas, better looking bouncepads etc. A lot of textures have been replaced with better versions, such as Bot Arena 8 having a textural makeover. Not all arenas have been updated with the new graphical elements yet. Around about half of them are due to be updated with the new features.
[/olist]

OTHER CHANGES / ENHANCEMENTS

[olist]
[*] Player controls image in menus updated to include the new player abilities.

[*] Inflatable exploding balls now grow twice as big before exploding. They also collide with each other now, making them more useful for smothering enemies in tight spaces.

[*] Arena randomization / generation improvements in Arena 1 and Bot Arena 5.

[*] Low player health warnings appear a bit earlier.

[*] Most player weapons are now disabled while the player is dashing (making it harder to dash into your own bullets and rockets)

[*] All PvP matches now set player healths to 400 by default, regardless of difficulty settings. The increased health also makes PvP matches last longer.

[*] Spawned player turrets now rotate slower, making it easier to aim a more precise shot.

[*] Player spawned shield walls now have extra collision detection, making it less likely enemies can shoot through them by standing up close.

[*] Player sword now inflict damage by causing small explosions on collision.

[*] The new sidestep ability automatically zooms the camera in much closer to the player.

[*] Trooper 5 (blue robot that can rocket boost over walls) now has a sound effect when using the rocket boost ability.

[*] Trooper 2 (Shotgunner) now has its shotgun blasts disabled while dashing at player.

[*] Trooper 1 remodelled to look more robotic and thin.

[*] Trooper 2 (sword and grenade attacks) slightly remodelled and colour changed from pink to purple.

[*] Fixed - Hoverboard gun not firing.

[*] Fixed - Hoverboard moving through shield walls.

[*] Fixed - player movement speed differing between the two major game modes
[/olist]
This isn't a complete list of all changes, so you may find a handful of other surprizes. Please give feedback on the discussion page to let me know what you think of the update and what you'd like to see added or changed next. And if you're enjoying the game leave a short review on the game's Store Page. Thanks.

notes.title: Menu improvements, gameplay instructions, and assorted gameplay tweaks.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] HOW TO PLAY instructions added to main menu.
[*] Significant A.I. improvements made to Troop 4 bot. Is now a lot more aggressive.
[*] Bot spawners, pushable cannons and hoverboards now generate sparks to indicate when their health is low.
[*] A handful of improvements to layout randomization in several arenas.
[*] Some layout randomization added to the first two rooms of Bot Arena 6.
[*] Flamethrower tweaks. Rate of fire reduced, as the weapons was a bit overpowered. Also lessened the particle effects of fire as it was affecting frame rate in multiplayer.
[*] Elevator speeds fixed in Arena 9 (previously way too fast).
[*] Bot spawners will spawn replacements for killed bots more quickly.
[*] Players in both game modes now start all matches armed with grenades and a pistol, instead of empty handed.
[/list]

More updates coming very soon!
